rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no 'fixed' retrospectives, no session biography.
Register match.
Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file, not an article draft.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
Always 'you', never 'the student'; teacher framing stays out of body.
Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
Over-hedge detector.
Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no frame citations required.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no practitioner attributions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
Watch out for planting jargon too early.
Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no exercise closers with forcing functions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Past tense for exercise recap sections — heading and body.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file, not an exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference page; not a teaching beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: AE101 is engineering audience, not business; rule applies to Agents 101.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference page; memory/context not the subject matter.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body — THIS RULE HAS AN EXCEPTION; read to the boundary before cutting anything.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference lookup page; not an exercise narrative.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no prompt blocks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file, not an exercise/module with debrief.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no module-voice smuggling concern.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no Claude-output auditing in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no simulations.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No 'What research says' callout boxes
Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no student moves described.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: No CLAUDE.md references in body; maintainer block appropriate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file with declarative headers; rule applies to exercises/debriefs.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
Session / task / run split (all trainings).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; not a session/task/run context.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no pedagogical beats.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no meta-loops.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference page; not about student-saved artifacts.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
Body 'read it' / 'look at it' / 'notice X' after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no chat-print scenarios.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file; no forward-looking callouts.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reference file IS the operational reference; rule satisfied by design.
